title: Fresh Pineapple Rum
description: In this super easy recipe, golden rum is infused with fresh pineapple to give your favorite drinks a refreshing, tropical flavor boost.
ingredients: 1 ripe pineapple - peeled, cored, and cut into chunks
1 (750 milliliter) bottle gold Barbados rum (such as Mount Gay® or Trader Joe's® Rum of the Gods)

steps.text: Place pineapple in a large glass container. Pour in rum, covering pineapple completely.
Store container on a cool, dark shelf, stirring and tasting once a day, until rum reaches desired flavor, at least 1 week but preferably 2.

video.description: Add more sweet and sour tropical flavor to your favorite drinks with this super-easy fruit infusion. All you need is a pineapple and a bottle of gold rum. Cut up your pineapple, douse it with pure Barbados island rum and wait for a week or two (two weeks is worth the wait!). When you strain out the fruit, you’ll be left with a rum so tasty you’ll enjoy sipping it straight, but you’ll love how it elevates your margaritas, mai tais and other rum cocktails into tropical paradise for your total enjoyment.
